description: Lists the objects marked for check-in in a local session as {session:{index, name, path}, conflictedOnly, markings:[{handle, type, name, markState, isUpToDate, isMarkedByMe, isMarkedByOthers}], total, nextCursor}, read in real time from the Project Server. Marking selects objects of YOUR local session for check-in; other users only see them as marked in another local session. conflicted:true lists only the conflicted markings (an object also marked in another local session, or out of date), which must be resolved before check-in. Every object has a `handle` for the tia_obj_* tools. For a large session read it in pages: pass limit (1-1000), then pass the nextCursor of each page as cursor until nextCursor is null. Without limit and cursor the whole list is returned. A page is refused with 409 paging_unavailable (details.incomplete, details.total) when the ancestry of some marked objects cannot be read: call again without limit and cursor, or retry. `session` is the name or the full path of an open local session (as listed by tia_local_sessions; the project path first, then the project name ignoring case) and may be left out when exactly one session is open: none open is 409 no_local_session, several open without `session` (or a selector that matches several) is 409 ambiguous_session (details.sessions lists index, name and path), an unknown one is 404 not_found. Needs a running TIA Portal on the serve host (tia_start) but no open project. Maps to GET /multiuser/localsessions/markings?session=&conflicted=&limit=&cursor= (all optional). Read-only (class R).

conflicted.description: true = only the conflicted markings; omit or false = every marking

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

session.description: name or full path of the open local session (from tia_local_sessions); optional when exactly one session is open

name: tia_markings
title: TIA — objects marked for check-in
